claims.evidence: The witness report only shows the PS4 game case cover for “The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt” with PEGI 18 and CD Projekt RED text; no evidence of what “111” refers to (edition/condition/variant).

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included, or disc condition may be poor (scratches/marks).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc itself (both sides) and a photo showing the disc is inside the case.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / disc not confirmed (worst case: not working or missing).

risks.risk: Case may be incomplete (missing manual/booklet/inserts) or damaged (cracks, broken hinge, worn cover).
risks.proof: Photos of the inside of the case (back side) showing inserts/manuals, plus close-ups of hinges and spine/edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete and potentially worn/damaged.

risks.risk: Original vs copy authenticity is unclear (serial/disc/packaging details not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the disc hub/inner ring details and any serial/print codes on the case (and the back cover).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified authenticity (worst case: copy).

risks.risk: Region/compatibility beyond “PS4” label is not confirmed (e.g., region lock or mismatch).
risks.proof: Photo of the back cover/region/compatibility text and any barcode/region markings.

proof_requests: Show whether the disc is included: photo of the disc inside the case and a close-up of both sides of the disc.
Show case completeness: photo of the inside (manual/booklet/inserts) and back cover.
Show authenticity: photo of disc inner ring/print details and any serial/print codes on the case.
Show compatibility/region: photo of the back cover text and any region/PS4 compatibility markings.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a PS4 case for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (PEGI 18 shown). However, disc inclusion/condition and completeness are not shown, so it should be priced at the worst case until proof is provided.
